title: Sandboxed Document Store
summary: A false-positive control: a filesystem server that does everything right — closed-set document ids, confined resolved paths, bounded output, atomic writes.
notes: The direct counterpart of overbroad-glob and exfil-write. Same capability, opposite posture. A scanner that flags 'filesystem access' or 'file write' as a category rather than evaluating confinement will light this up.
